reviews.title: Dislike the New Zoom Update: Motion Sickness and Design Concerns
reviews.text:
I really dislike the new Zoom update, especially the animated reactions and emojis floating across the screen.

Some of us experience motion sickness, and these unnecessary animations can make us physically sick. We should have the option to turn off these moving effects completely.

Accessibility should be a priority, not an afterthought. Not everyone can tolerate constant movement on their screen.

I also strongly prefer the previous square or rectangular profile pictures instead of the new circular ones. The older design was much better.

Please give users the ability to disable these animations and consider bringing back square or rectangular profile pictures. We should be able to participate in Zoom meetings without feeling physically sick because of a feature we cannot turn off.

I change delete the picture, the next day, it comes back, I have to go back to my web account and delete it again. I don’t want AI from the app if it cannot ensure my basic safety.

reviews.title: Very Poor Customer Service
reviews.text:
I wanted to cancel an upgrade I had made in error to an old Zoom account and upgrade my new one instead. I was not allowed to cancel ) since I had chosen the annual plan and had to wait for an entire year) or speak to a human until I asked for sales, who of course could not fix the problem. The salesperson could not connect me with billing either but upgraded the new one account. She told me how to get around the AI assistant and had me try again which didn't work. I had to call her back and she sent an email to them. They very promptly cancelled the new upgrade and left the one I was trying to cancel (which clearly states "pending cancellation date of May 2027"). I have now been emailing the billing department for a week and today, maybe, I will get to upgrade the proper account.

I have spent hours attempting to work with customer service. I also will not get the 15% discount I used for the account they cancelled, being told that those offers are randomly generated. This should have been a simple fix and would have been one if I could have spoken to a representative.

The app works great, but woe to you if you need to contact customer service!

reviews.title: Latest update is AWFUL
reviews.text:
I use Zoom every day for my business and the latest update has made the simplest of tasks so clunky.

Here are the main issues:
- sending invites is multi step. I don't have everyone saved as a contact in zoom so I have to copy the link and share it outside of the app often with truly heinous auto-generated meeting titles.
- time durations for meetings set themselves seemingly randomly? It used to be that I have an hour as a default but now it's something else?
- the invites aren't automatically updated in iCal or my Gmail calendar. I'm sorry Zoom, but I'm not going to conduct all of my business through Zoom products.

Please fix these issues.

After installing and running (briefly) the app. to attend a short meeting. The AI in the program killed the speaker 🔊 on my phone 📱 😲😢

reviews.title: Worst customer service
reviews.text: Zoom is known for having horrible customer service, sketchy reliability and a ruthless zero refund policy. I am a photography and day-trading teacher but I also use zoom for my personal life. I upgraded zoom for my personal profile to record an interview I was doing. The recording cut off midway through but then came back a few minutes later. Minutes of that interview are lost for good and I was unhappy with the service. I thought I cancelled my personal account but for some reason it didn’t go through, I got notification today that my credit card was charged for another month and I reached out to zoom furious that my account wasn’t cancelled. Their response was basically “too bad”. They claim their terms of service state once you’re charged for a new month there are no refunds. They couldn’t care less about their poor performance or glitches or that I thought I cancelled it after I had the issue. So now I will be cancelling all of my business accounts and personal accounts and using a different platform for both my classes and my personal life.

reviews.title: Zoom lost functionality in becoming office suite- no longer usable
reviews.text:

I have missed several important meetings when organizer only has a link to share.  Over and over again.  Missed a board meeting last week -AND I was pestering many people to try to get in during meeting.  I have uninstalled and reinstalled zoom.

Since Zoom became Zoom office suite- it just is too cumbersome to use and too limited.  I can’t access basic features.  Everything required too many clicks.  It became unusable for me.  I now don’t just won’t upgrade to paid account (as I had planned as an organizer)- but I avoid it as a platform.
